questions.question: Mention various scripts of Syriac language .
questions.solution_html:
• Syriac language: 22 letters- right to left- Estrangela the ancient Syriac script- East
  • Syriac- West Syriac- East Syriac developed by school of Nisibis, Joseph Hazzaya
  • Narsai- Called Chaldean Maronite, West Syriac developed by Edessan school –
  • Called Antiochean.( Introduction- 2marks, Three Scripts 3marks, Conclusion- 1
  • Marks)

questions.question: Write various scripts of Syriac language and its origin?
questions.solution_html:
• Different scripts in Syriac.
  • Syriac has three scripts- Estrangela- East Syriac- West Syriac
  • The ancient form of Syriac script is Estrangela- East Syriac developed by Nisibis- West
  • Syriac developed by school of Edessa.

questions.question: Explain the mission of St. Thomas in India based on Act of Thomas .
questions.solution_html:
• Act of Thomas: Apocryphal literature- Thomas the Apostle- 3rd Century- Edessa-13
  • sections- Work of St. Thomas in India to His martyrdom- King Gundnaphur- Arrival
  • at Sandruk- Wedding feast- Hymn of the bride, Hymn of Pearl.( About the text-2, Act
  • of Thomas main content- 2marks, Conclusion- 2marks)

questions.question: What are the main events described in the Act of Thomas ?
questions.solution_html:
• Act of Thomas:
  • A Syriac text written on 3 rd century at Edessa- This text describe the Apostle’s mission in
  • India and narrative is set out 13 sections called acts- The work provides dramatic
  • narratives of Thomas miraculous evangelistic adventures in India- Two poems
  • incorporated with this text: Hymn of Bride and Hymn of Pearl.
